headline: Robert's call is today, Evan and luca tomorrow. Three shows in 48 hours decide the shape of August.

sections.title: Do today
sections.text: Robert Gutierrez calls today: confirmation sent, proof pre loaded, and the new Pre Call Emails folder put to work for the first time. Confirm Evan and luca for tomorrow tonight. Pin Josh's time, booked nine days without one. And the EUR 5,000 still needs its Payments tab row, Rhys's EUR 375 commission reads from it.

sections.title: Watch
sections.text: Show rate: 57 percent measured against the 60 floor, and three calls in 48 hours. Every saved show is worth about EUR 2,500 in expected cash. Volume holds at 37 a day on main only while account 2 finishes setup; its first sends this week begin the two to three week warm up clock toward 105.
